answer: A funder can mint voting skins overnight if intake never prices a scarce production trail. Each new agent books a 19-hour kiln ticket at a public timber yard: it locks 33.6 POA, then every 42 minutes posts a 28-byte moisture-ring hash plus a violet vat lot tied to its first inbound funding parent. Peers overlay lots on a 5-wallet cluster graph; tickets sharing a vat lot and parent inside 12 hours lose 55% of the bond and the oasis intake window shuts 30 hours. If two probe slots go silent, the ticket voids and the lock returns minus a 2.1 POA fee, so idle clones cannot squat cheaply.
